statement: Before a speedrun set up equipment and food and talent distribution and gather as many outside multikill sources as possible
First equipment priority is hitting the 350% movement speed cap; extra speed gives only slightly more damage
Use equipment food and potions to get at least 350 movement speed
Second priority is enough damage; more damage hits more multikill damage tiers so multikill benefits more
Third priority is as much multikill from as many sources as possible; clears maps faster and a few percent can unlock one more portal
Use best armor; full Magma set gives most damage
Max out upgrade slots for luck before the run since luck raises total damage
He uses Golden Food Effect helmet but it is not optimal; use the best helmet you have
Hallowed Tail Pendant is best in slot neck for the extra multikill
Without Hallowed Tail Pendant alternatives: Crescent Moon pendant for mob respawn; Chizoar's Caustic Scarf for respawn and damage
He prefers multikill over damage from the neck since his damage already clears most worlds
Deathly Cluster Pendant gives more mob respawn as another option below Hallowed Tail Pendant
Rings should be Emperor's Opal unless you have World 1-4 rings for extra kills in specific worlds
Change world rings as you go through worlds; if you will forget use Obol rings instead
Last option Tenacity Ring for more total damage
Ram Ring gives 4% more damage if you have none of the other rings
AFK gain rate gear does not help in speedrun; only want damage and multikill
Use V-man Name Tag for more multikill per tier plus some luck and weapon power
Trinkets: use percent luck for damage or Pincer Hand Chain for more multikill
Lab chips that double keychain bonuses greatly boost multikill e.g. a 24% Pincer Hand doubled
Use tools as stat sticks; put any luck you can on them to raise damage
Putting luck on each tool at Void gave another 300M damage
Top food priority is reaching 350% movement speed cap
Anything that boosts Feasty Statue increases movement speed from foods
You do not need many of these foods for a good speedrun
Next food priority is damage: Golden Kebabs for total damage or Potent Strength Potion
Golden Nomiches with a big stack give decent damage but he gets more from Potent Strength Potion currently
Last food option is anything increasing base luck
Max Void Trial Rerun; each point gives 1.5 more seconds and helps unlock more portals
Next split points between Void Radius and Bossing Vain; at least some in each
Bossing Vain matters more if you can go far; if you clear only one or two worlds Void Radius is bigger priority
After one or two runs you should have many points in these two talents to push further
Void Radius gives more multikill for 20 additional seconds after use so timing it matters
Void Radius is a map clear so do not use it when the portal for that map is almost complete; save it for next map
Bossing Vain gives portal count per boss kill: Amarok normal 1 chaotic 2 nightmare 3
Quad Jab is next priority; small bonus since you one-shot most mobs but extra damage if lacking
VooDoo Statufication is good if you have statues to level; boosts Feasty Statue for food effect so fewer slots used on potions
Master of the System gives more multikill; not useful on first or second run as it depends on speedrun high score
Eternal Luck is a huge damage bonus for the V-man
Eternal Luck gives 400 base luck plus 400 more if Lucky Horseshoe is maxed
Spare points can go into Power Orb for a bit more damage
Last priority: Eternal STR AGI WIS for small bonuses via alchemy bubbles for health mana and movement speed
Maestro tab: Bliss N Chips gives more points to Lucky Horseshoe
Skillage Damage gives damage from skill levels; Skilliest Statue boosts Feasty and Kapow statues
Triple Jab gives more damage; big priority for him to push later high-health mobs if you cannot one-shot
Clever Clover Obols not worth it; put points into Jman Was Better for more Tab 2 points to max Lucky Horseshoe
Put at least a few points in Coin Toss to kill a few more mobs if struggling on mob kills
Lucky Horseshoe gives base luck and should be biggest priority on Tab 2
F'LUK'ey Fabrics gives more luck from equipment; big if stats maxed and upgrade stones used
Lucky Hit increases damage from luck; very big priority and max it
Max Lucky Hit even over putting some points into Lucky Horseshoe
Two Punch Man is another damage source alongside Triple and Quad Jabs
A few points in Indiana Attack help clear maps easier; everything else optional
Tab 1 biggest priority: Gilded Sword and Sharpened Axe for base damage
Then points into Lucky Clover to boost luck
Other Tab 1 talents give small damage via alchemy bubbles for strength wisdom agility health mana and movement speed
Knuckle Buster last priority as it only gives crit hit damage
Points in Sleepin' on the Job are useless for speedrun; consider respeccing before the run
Star talents for damage: Best Beginner Class for weapon power and Will of the Eldest for base stat
Goblet of Hemoglobin is not bad as healing in case defense is too low to survive mobs
Tab 2: Dungeonic Damage gives damage based on dungeon progress and Frothy Malk gives a good food bonus
Mega Crit worth taking: with over 100% crit chance mega crits deal 300% more damage and it is not at max level
Tab 3: Stat Overload gives STR AGI WIS LUK and is a significant boost for Voidwalker
Overaccurate Crit is useful only if below 100 crit chance; use it to reach 100% for mega crits
Tiptoe Quickness is useless as accuracy is not a problem and you will be way over 200% speed
World 1 Multikill Stamp gives more base multikill
World 2 large bubble Kill per Kill gives more kills to portals
Mr Massacre bubble gives more multikill
Big P bubble raises the bonus from Minor Links on Divinity statues; covered in World 5
Slowergy Drink vial gives base multikill; expensive but worth leveling
Post Office utility box gives more multikill
Other good post office boxes: damage boxes food box and dropbox for luck
Get as many multikill obols as possible in personal and family tabs
If no multikill obols use as many luck obols as possible for damage
Chizoar obols give percent damage and Troll Obol gives percent to stats
Balance of Pain prayer gives more multikill at cost of defense and accuracy
Skip Fibers of Absence; lowers total damage for more death note kills which nets about the same
Salt Lick bonus needing purple salts gives more multikill; expensive but worth leveling
Death Note bonuses count for multikill; level skulls to Lava Skulls or higher before speedrun and max death note bonuses
Killer's Brightside doubles counts from portals and death notes
Put a few more characters in lab from normal and max Orange Jewels for 30% more damage on all characters
Console chips should double cards if you have that bonus; significant
Also bonuses to double pendants and keychain slots
Without those slots max as many multikill chips as possible
Without multikill chips use Basic Attack Speed or Monster Respawn or Weapon Power chips
Artifact Trilobite Rock gives more multikill per damage tier
Trilobite Rock gives 50% at Ancient and 75% at Eldritch form
Nobisect is another 2x kills to portals and death note and stacks with lab for 4x
Using Big P large bubble gives roughly another 20% total damage
Two cards give more multikill
Suggma card gives 10 multikill per tier
Clammie card gives additional 7% multikill per tier
Rest of cards should give more damage on Voidwalker to help push farther
Card set options: Bosses and Nightmares for damage or Food Effect set for movement speed depending on need
Arcade shop multikill per tier upgrade is expensive and slow but nice if you have it
A multikill star sign gives 15% more multikill
With infinite star signs The Bulwark gives damage but needs more movement speed; The Overachiever gives damage
Do not care about fight AFK gain rate star sign effects
Some maps unlock two portals; in Bean Map unlocking portal for Birch Enclave without entering it
Kill one or two more in Bean Map to unlock two portals; Slime map also unlocks Stick Map
Use Void Radius in Walking Stick Map to nearly instantly unlock Nutto Map giving two nearly free portals
After clearing Nuttos teleport down to Snakes then continue to boss room
Have enough keys to unlock the highest boss you can kill since harder bosses give more counts
Killing the Nightmare boss gives three additional portals
After clearing the boss do not go back out; teleport to next world and continue
Optimized routes are being found every day; use a better route if you see one
On spawn hit mushrooms and run through maps; Auto is not optimized until certain areas
On Bean Map kill one or two more to unlock one more portal
If using Auto use the map to teleport around for more overall kill count
Use Void Radius then head up to the top of the map; always move toward portal
Do not get stuck fighting mobs near the map entrance
Kill a few Nuttos then teleport to Snake Map and head for the portal without stopping at the start
Go to the base of the map to unlock the Boss Portal first; fight a few mobs then head back up
Do not use Voidification before the boss; use it when you come out; fight Nightmare boss quickly then head back out
After boss use Voidification then teleport to Sandy Pots; one or two kills unlock next map; only 20 seconds so kill as many as possible
Moving on quickly to next zones; Mafiosos take about one or two kills
Head to top of sand castles map; use attacks and Voidification as often as possible; keep moving toward portal
At Sands of Time use teleports more since large maps waste time
Kill one or two Snelbies then enter Efaunt room; boss takes more time so plan for it
Use Coin Toss from bottom rung at Efaunt to skip fighting the arm and save time
Time Voidification for when it is up at the snow maps since they need much more kill count
Do not get trapped; go downstairs for the portal on the Stashes map not upstairs which needs far more portal kills
Current strat: teleport to Sir Stache map to use Voidification to unlock Rams for a few more kills then teleport back to start
He used Voidification too early; should have waited to clear a full map instead of finishing half-cleared blocks
On Snowmans kill as many as possible while Voidification is up; start using auto as time spent grows
With Auto on leave the map up until the golden dot opens then teleport instantly; saves seconds each map
Keep watching your Voidification timer
After the run you teleport to World 1 town and can check talent points for a new high score
Every additional portal gives more talent points so spend them and try for a better score
Near the end push for the boss or anything giving portal counts even by switching worlds
He could have teleported to World 4 zones for easier kill counts than bot boxes but went for Chizoar worth three portals and fell short
He can optimize Void Radius use more; turn off the setting using autos during auto attack when using Auto
When using Auto utilize teleporting to the new map instead of turning Auto off and running
